segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: Achilles, no man was ever more blessed, nor will be: alive we honored you like a god, and here you rule with power among the dead. Do not grieve at dying — you of all men.
segments.delivery: attempting consolation, offering earned praise, and narrating Neoptolemus's deeds

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: Would you hear of Peleus, and of your son Neoptolemus? Of your father I know nothing — but of the boy I can speak truly, for I myself brought him from Scyros to the war.
segments.delivery: attempting consolation, offering earned praise, and narrating Neoptolemus's deeds

segments.speaker: odysseus
segments.caption: In council he spoke first and best; in battle he never lagged in the crowd, but charged far ahead. When we crouched inside the wooden horse the other chiefs wept and trembled — he only gripped his sword-hilt and begged me to let him leap out. And he took his prize and sailed home unwounded.
